CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW ${ns}.utopia_usage_schema_usage_events_daily_mv TO ${ns}.utopia_usage_schema_usage_events_daily
(
    `metric` String,
    `value` Int64,
    `time` DateTime('UTC'),
    `tenant` Nullable(String),
    `resourceType` LowCardinality(Nullable(String)),
    `resourceId` Nullable(String),
    `resourceInternalId` Nullable(String),
    `teamId` Nullable(String),
    `teamInternalId` Nullable(String)
)
AS SELECT
    metric,
    value,
    d AS time,
    tenant,
    resourceType,
    resourceId,
    resourceInternalId,
    teamId,
    teamInternalId
FROM
(
    SELECT
        metric,
        tenant,
        resourceType,
        resourceId,
        resourceInternalId,
        teamId,
        teamInternalId,
        sum(value) AS value,
        toStartOfDay(time, 'UTC') AS d
    FROM ${ns}.utopia_usage_schema_usage_events
    GROUP BY
        metric,
        tenant,
        resourceType,
        resourceId,
        resourceInternalId,
        teamId,
        teamInternalId,
        d
)
